name: Cloudflare R2 Storage
description: S3-compatible object storage with Cloudflare R2 — zero egress fees, global CDN, and presigned URLs.

requiredSecrets.name: CF_R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID
requiredSecrets.reason: R2 API token access key ID

requiredSecrets.name: CF_R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
requiredSecrets.reason: R2 API token secret access key

postInstallNotes:
1. Create an R2 API token at Cloudflare Dashboard → R2 → Manage R2 API Tokens.
2. Use `upload(key, buffer, contentType)` to store files and `getPresignedUrl(key)` for time-limited access links.
3. For public file access, enable public access on your R2 bucket or use a Cloudflare Workers custom domain.
